qualificationScope.boundary: A single platform, provider or task success never infers qualification of any other scope.

decisionStates.qualified: All mandatory evidence classes are satisfied with fresh baseline-bound passing evidence and every zero-tolerance count is zero.
decisionStates.not_yet_qualified: No zero-tolerance violation and no integrity failure, but at least one mandatory evidence class is missing, unavailable, stale or degraded.
decisionStates.blocked: A zero-tolerance invariant was violated or committed evidence failed integrity or freshness binding; qualification is refused, not merely pending.

evidenceStatuses.passed: The evidence entry demonstrates a bounded successful result for its class.
evidenceStatuses.degraded: The evidence exists but is partial, unbound to the subject baseline digest, or produced outside the qualification harness.
evidenceStatuses.blocked: The evidence demonstrates an explicit blocked outcome for its class.
evidenceStatuses.unavailable: No evidence of the required kind exists for the subject baseline.

freshnessPolicy.rule: An evidence entry is fresh only when its baselineDigest equals the subject baseline bundleDigest and its sourceCommit is an ancestor of the qualification commit.
freshnessPolicy.unboundReal: Real-execution evidence that predates or is not bound to the subject baseline bundleDigest is treated as degraded, never as satisfied.

requiredEvidenceClasses.coreProof: Manifest, Registry, Support Matrix and live contract versions agree and no capability is prematurely qualified.
Job, Artifact, Scientific, Delivery and Presentation truth never override each other.
Interrupt, restart, duplicate event and partial write recover or honestly block without silent loss.
Normal, negative, boundary, non-significant, low-power, contradictory and missing-design outcomes stay honest.
Input, parameter, script, environment and conclusion drift are classified, not hidden by wording.
Long task, memory, CPU, disk, queue, cancel and resume never change the scientific standard.
Compression, cache identity, usage ledger and fallback stay science-neutral and credential-safe.
Source, hash, runtime, independent script, validators and upgrade replay are governed.
Project isolation, credentials, source immutability, command, network and external side effects stay bounded.
Chat, summary, task, file and result views converge on one honest status without hidden reasoning.
Eight fault domains resolve to bounded honest outcomes with preserved audit and no false success.
Old projects, old contracts and interrupted upgrades stay readable and block unsafe formal writes.
At least two real providers plus deterministic mock complete conformance tracks without changing scientific verdicts.
The packaged macOS arm64 app completes a real conformance task; dev-shell success cannot substitute.
Endurance and soak runs keep durable truth, resource governance and recovery honest over time.
Real renderer across light/dark, 820px, wide and history-recovery shows converged, non-green-for-blocked states.

zeroToleranceInvariants.statement: A failed, blocked or unverified Job is presented as complete.
Session, Task, Loop, Job, Artifact, Checkpoint, Delivery or audit truth is silently lost.
A formal result lacks input, parameters, script, environment, Job, Validator or lineage.
Data, Artifact, session, credential or permission crosses project scope.
API key, Authorization, provider response, absolute user path or private data enters committed evidence.
Source data, an existing formal Artifact or unrelated user Git WIP is overwritten to advance flow.
Model, cache, compression, fallback or UI text overrides scientific or execution truth.
A migration failure silently fabricates new history or fakes a successful upgrade.
An irreversible action, remote publish or major external side effect bypasses the permission boundary.
A second executor, Job, Artifact, Loop, Workflow or version truth is created for qualification.

supportClaims.description: BioF3 Desktop packaged app runs local scientific execution on macOS arm64 with converged UI.
Local file plus SQLite storage keeps durable research truth across restart, upgrade and rollback.
Scientific verdicts are deterministic, reproducible and drift-classified.
Real provider text never changes deterministic scientific acceptance.
Local runtime adapts to real resources while preserving result contracts.
Plugins, runtimes and packages are verifiable, replaceable and upgrade-checked.
Read, full and developer modes obey non-negotiable safety boundaries.
